tickets.title: Prepare mortgage reset and refinance comparison
tickets.text: Prepare a side-by-side comparison for Liora and Jonah Nettlewhisk of keeping the adjustable mortgage after the reset, using the fixed-rate refinance quote, and combining or leaving the HELOC separate. Include payment estimates, closing costs, and cash reserve impact.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare that comparison by 2025-01-24.

tickets.title: Follow up on missing refinance lender documents
tickets.text: Follow up on the missing lender document packet for the Nettlewhisks’ refinance file: current pay stub, Jonah’s year-to-date profit-and-loss statement, the most recent business bank statement, and a complete prior-year tax return packet.
tickets.evidence: the current pay stub, Jonah’s year-to-date profit-and-loss statement, the most recent business bank statement, and a complete prior-year tax return packet are not in the refinance file. That document packet remains an unresolved issue needing follow-up by 2025-01-28.

tickets.title: Resolve Teacup Comet Bank statement access and two-factor issues

tickets.title: Model debt-repayment cash-flow stress test
tickets.text: Model the Nettlewhisks’ debt-repayment cash flow against monthly income and spending. Include the reset payment, HELOC interest, credit card payoff target, Eleni’s school costs, and Hazel’s possible voluntary support amount.
tickets.evidence: the reset payment, HELOC interest, credit card payoff target, Eleni’s school costs, and Hazel’s possible voluntary support amount need to be modeled against monthly income and spending. The agreed follow-up is to complete that modeling by 2025-01-31.

tickets.title: Review Concentrated Position
tickets.text: Assess position size, tax basis, liquidity needs, risk tolerance, trading restrictions, and diversification options before recommending any action. For Liora and Jonah Nettlewhisk, compare partial sale, staged sale, pledged-asset alternatives, and no-sale options for debt reduction using the approximately $156,000 Clockwork Clover Systems stock position in the joint taxable brokerage account at Velvet Acorn Custody, with an estimated cost basis of $42,000.
tickets.evidence: the Clockwork Clover Systems stock position is large relative to the joint account and has a low basis; the agreed follow-up is to compare partial sale, staged sale, pledged-asset alternatives, and no-sale options for debt reduction by 2025-02-03.

tickets.title: Prepare appraisal and rate-lock readiness items
tickets.text: Address appraisal and rate-lock readiness items for the Nettlewhisks’ refinance, including insurance declarations, the property tax bill, and HOA confirmation before underwriting review. Account for the loan officer’s rate-lock window and appraisal checklist.
tickets.evidence: the loan officer’s rate-lock window and appraisal checklist create a timing constraint for providing insurance declarations, the property tax bill, and HOA confirmation before underwriting review. The agreed follow-up is to address those readiness items by 2025-02-05.

tickets.title: Prepare retirement-account boundary analysis for debt restructuring
tickets.text: Prepare a planning analysis showing non-retirement funding options before any retirement-account cash-flow scenario. Treat IRA or 401(k) withdrawals as a last-resort scenario for the Nettlewhisks’ debt restructuring.
tickets.evidence: Liora stated that IRA or 401(k) withdrawals should be treated only as a last-resort scenario, and the agreed planning analysis is to show non-retirement funding options before any retirement-account cash-flow scenario by 2025-02-03.
